title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!
description: After a traffic accident, Kazuma Sato’s disappointingly brief life was supposed to be over, but he wakes up to see a beautiful girl before him. She claims to be a goddess, Aqua, and asks if he would like to go to another world and bring only one thing with him. Kazuma decides to bring the goddess herself, and they are transported to a fantasy world filled with adventure, ruled by a demon king. Now Kazuma only wants to live in peace, but Aqua wants to solve many of this world’s problems, and the demon king will only turn a blind eye for so long…

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Gamer Kazuma dies in a freak accident, and is met in the afterlife by a crass goddess, Aqua.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: It's great for Kazuma that he brought Aqua along with  him, but unlike in a game world, much is missing from his adventurer's  lifestyle. No money, no equipment, and even fighting the lowest ranking  monsters is a hard-fought battle. That's when they decide to recruit new  party members.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: A low-grade goddess turned arch priest who works hard to acquire party trick skills, a disappointing arch wizard who can only unleash explosion magic once per day, and Kazuma himself, whose only redeeming quality is his good luck. Kazuma despairs over the completely useless party that's been formed.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: All of the weak monsters have gone into hiding since a leader of the devil king's army has settled in near town. Kazuma, who had been focusing on improving his skills, is stuck at a standstill. With nothing else to do, Kazuma tags along with Megumin's training, which consists of unleashing explosion magic into an abandoned castle.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: With debt looming over her, Aqua convinces Kazuma to  accept a high difficulty quest to purify a lake, which doesn't require  killing any monsters.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Dullahan, a top leader in the Devil King's army, yet again appears at the city in a frenzied rage.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: "I want money." After paying back the debt Aqua has racked up, Kazuma and Aqua's monetary situation grows even more dire. The party accepts a quest to kill helpless Snow Sprites and heads for the snowy mountains in order to escape from the stables during this winter so cold it freezes Kazuma's eyelashes solid.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and Aqua can't properly accept rewards from quests due to their mediocre party lineup, and are so destitute that even keeping wood on the fire is difficult. Kazuma comes up with a plan and visits a magical accessories shop run by a woman called Wiz.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kazuma runs into some adventurers he knows while out for a walk and decides to go with them to a shop run by succubi said to show its customers enticing dreams.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The rampaging ancient weapon: the mobile fortress, Destroyer, is headed straight for Kazuma and party's city!

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Darkness, Aqua, and Megumin are back to continue their quest against the Devil King. Kazuma is back too, but the only adventures he has waiting for him exist within the criminal justice system.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and Aqua meet Yunyun, a Crimson Demon girl who claims to be Megumin's rival. The feuding magic users then square off in a competition that could have ruinous repercussions for both of them.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: A new discovery in a previously mapped out dungeon might be the first step toward Kazuma repaying his massive debt. Unfortunately for him, Aqua is determined to help.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Darkness is back, but not to stay, if Kazuma and her father have anything to say about it.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: As a result of a magic circle that Aqua had drawn in Keele's dungeon, strange explosive doll monsters have started to appear, putting the town at risk.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Kazuma is surprised to discover that Vanir had an extra life and has since quit his position as a commander to work at Wiz's shop, striking up a business partnership to sell products from Kazuma's world.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Vanir gives Kazuma the choice of either selling the intellectual rights for his real world products for a one-off payment of 300 million eris, or maintaining a profit-sharing contract of 1 million eris a month.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and the others manage to lure the kite hawks into a cave and deal with them all at once, only to cause more trouble for the other travelers later when Aqua attracts some zombies.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The party makes their way to Arcanretia, a city known for it's recuperative hot springs! But what they don't know about the city might spell doom for their vacation.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Evading the angry mob, the gang discover that the source of the town's water is being poisoned by the man from earlier, who is revealed to be one of the Devil King's army leaders, Hans the Deadly Poison Slime.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After defeating Sylvia at the Crimson Demon Village, Kazuma and his party look forward to receiving a reward that could mean freedom from the grind of having to fulfill quests. Kazuma himself, however, seems to be having nightmares and bouts of paranoia.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and the gang receive a letter from Princess Iris. She wants to share a meal with them while hearing about their adventures. While Kazuma is giddy with wonderment of her beauty, Darkness is terrified of heads rolling in the event of any rudeness.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: What started as dinner at Darkness's mansion with Princess Iris has turned into Kazuma being dragged back to the castle! Rain explains the situation, and Kazuma agrees to keep Iris company. His wild stories leave the princess with stars in her eyes.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Kazuma thinks of a way to stay in the capital for Iris's sake, and declares that he will capture the thief who's causing a stir in the streets! Since the thief targets nobles with bad behavior, Kazuma and his friends decide to stay at Alderp's mansion.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The Devil King's army attack alarm rings in the royal capital! The adventurer's guild calls on high-level adventurers to join the battle. Having failed to capture the thief at Alderp's mansion, Kazuma joins the fight in order to redeem his reputation.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Chris tells Kazuma that the necklace he and Iris swapped bodies with is a sacred treasure, and it is dangerous and can threaten lives depending on its use. Princess Iris is in danger! Two robbers dressed in black sneak into the royal castle at night!

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and his friends return to Axel and receive 300 million eris as a reward for subjugating Sylvia, an executive of the Devil King's army. Kazuma and Aqua go to high-end restaurants, and Aqua enjoys her long-awaited life as a celebrity.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and the gang fail to defeat the hydra in the lake near Axel. The gang hopes to rely on knights from the capital, but they've been delayed due to a bandit disturbance for which a bounty has been issued. Darkness, however, is obsessed with the hydra.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Darkness departs the mansion leaving behind a note. Not satisfied by a single note, Kazuma, Aqua, and Megumin protest in front of the Dustiness manor but are rudely turned away. Kazuma, frustrated with everything, is approached by Dust who needs his help.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Darkness's wedding to Aldarp is imminent. Despite Aqua's and Megumin's pleas, Kazuma has no intention of intervening. Vanir then visits the mansion and reveals a shocking secret to Kazuma.

episodes_data.title: KONOSUBA – God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kazuma has crashed Darkness's wedding to Aldarp and pays him the two billion eris he says he's owed. Aqua and Kazuma try to make off with Darkness but Aldarp won't relinquish her so easily and orders his guards to stop their escape.
